review_evidence: README identifies the project as a formalization of Chapter 6, Special Numbers, of Concrete Mathematics.
SpecialNumbers/Euclidian.lean formalizes Euclid numbers, proving their product recurrence, pairwise coprimality, strict monotonicity, and a floor/exponential explicit formula.
SpecialNumbers/Sylvester.lean independently develops Sylvester sequence recurrence, coprimality, monotonicity, and an explicit formula via a limiting constant.
summary: Retain special-numbers: it formalizes special integer sequences from Concrete Mathematics with recurrence, coprimality, monotonicity, convergence, and explicit-formula theorems.
